thread:
Isha: Heads-up: AtlasMed wants a POC that guarantees EU-residency for both data and control-plane metadata. BYO-KMS required. They asked whether we can do VPC peering or if IP allowlist is sufficient for their auditors. cc @Ravi @Nora

Ravi (SE): Clarify: they want no telemetry or control signals to leave EU jurisdiction at any time, right? Also confirm whether self-hosted KMS in their account (BYO) or hosted customer key in EU is preferred.

Nora (acct): RFP: 'All data, telemetry, logs, and control-plane traffic must remain in EU. BYO-KMS in customer's AWS account (eu-west-1). VPC peering preferred; IP allowlist acceptable only with signed attestation.'

Sam (ops): Reality check: Hosted control plane is us-central. For POC we can do tenant pin to eu-west-1 + BYO-KMS + disable telemetry + opt-out third-party analytics. VPC peering will avoid Cloudflare edges but orchestration signals still touch our control plane unless we scope a temporary EU proxy.

legal-bot: Legal note: cannot certify Hosted as EU-control-plane. We can sign a time-limited technical attestation for a scoped POC describing mitigations (telemetry off, BYO-KMS, tenant pin, proxy) but contractual guarantee requires Dedicated or Private with EU-local control plane and subprocessors list.

Ravi: Proposed POC config to offer AtlasMed:
```yaml
tenant: atlasmed-poc
region_pin: eu-west-1
byo_kms: true
network: vpc_peering: true
telemetry: disabled
edge_cdn: disabled_for_tenant
control_plane_proxy: eu-resident-temp-proxy
failure_mode: reject
```

Isha: Good. Important: customer auditor flagged any subprocessor that can see request metadata as a blocker. Which subprocessors still see metadata in this POC?

Sam: With above config: payload stays in AWS eu-west-1. Audit logs delivered to customer's S3 (eu-west-1). Telemetry/tracing disabled. Remaining risk: short-lived control-plane orchestration signals to our us control plane mitigated by proxy; no persistent logs retained in US. We can disable Sentry/Datadog for tenant.

Ravi: Cost/ETA: Quick pilot (30 days, 200 req/day) estimated one-time setup ops ~$1.8k, pilot ops overhead ~$700/mo. Dedicated EU-control-plane for prod ballpark ~$11k+/mo. I'll refine when they confirm traffic.

Isha: Action items: Ravi to deliver one-page runbook + config snippet; Sam to open infra ticket for proxy + BYO-KMS tests; Legal to draft attestation language. Please drop artifacts here.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-9124 created: "AtlasMed POC - EU pin + BYO-KMS + proxy" assigned to Sam.

legal-bot: Draft attestation: "For the scoped 30-day POC, Redwood will: pin compute to EU (eu-west-1), configure customer-managed KMS in the customer's account, disable telemetry and third-party analytics for the tenant, route audit logs to the customer's EU S3, and route control-plane management through a temporary EU-resident proxy. This attestation is limited in time and scope; contractual EU-only control-plane guarantees require Dedicated/Private deployment and an approved subprocessor roster."

Nora: I'll send the attestation + rough quote to AtlasMed and ask if they accept temporary proxy + peering for POC. Keep updates here.
